audio.notes: Use the approved focus music bed during Compositing. Scene-level audio may be added later.

scenes.description: Open the video with a simple title card.
Show the empty chat app, click the new chat button, and confirm a fresh conversation is ready.
events: Navigate to the chat app.
Click the New chat button.
Wait for the chat status to show that a new chat is ready.
Confirm the previous conversation history is cleared.
Click Launch Plan Chat.
Confirm the saved conversation history is restored.
Pause on the restored chat.

scenes.description: Introduce the chat-starting workflow before the message composition capture.
Type a message into the chat box, send it, and show the deterministic assistant response.
events: Click the message input.
Type a short user message.
Click Send.
Wait for the user message to appear.
Wait for the assistant response to appear.
Confirm the transcript scrolled to the bottom.

scenes.description: Introduce the saved-chat review portion of the demo.
Hover over the archived chat item to reveal its action hint and show the app has saved conversations.
events: Navigate to the chat app.
Hover over the archived Launch Plan chat item.
Wait for the hover action hint to appear.
Pause on the highlighted chat item.

scenes.description: Scroll through the conversation transcript and show the older and newer messages in the same chat.
events: Navigate to the chat app.
Scroll down inside the message transcript.
Wait for the final checklist message to be visible.
Scroll back to the top of the message transcript.
Wait for the first welcome message to be visible.

scenes.description: Close with a static screenshot of the chat app and a clear call-to-action overlay.

image.alt: Screenshot of the Barebones Chat app showing saved messages and the message input.
